name: Curiosity Gap
description: Building curiosity by revealing only part of the information and encouraging the audience to discover the solution.
purpose: Increasing attention retention and ad watch time.
rules: Do not reveal the solution immediately.
Avoid clickbait that does not deliver on its promise.
The solution should be revealed later in the ad.

name: Social Proof
description: Building trust by showcasing reviews, results, numbers, or the product’s popularity.
purpose: Reducing concerns about making a purchase.
rules: Do not make broad claims without supporting evidence.

name: Authority
description: Messaging based on expert offer_profile, research, or the experience of specialists.
purpose: Building credibility for the product or brand.
rules: The expert should provide genuine value.

name: Education
description: Providing valuable offer_profile first and then introducing the product naturally.
rules: The product should be a natural extension of the content.
Do not turn the ad into a lecture.

name: Emotion
description: Building the message around emotions such as joy, relief, sentiment, or satisfaction.
purpose: Creating an emotional connection with the audience.
rules: The emotions should arise naturally from the story.

name: Humor
description: Capturing attention through humor or an amusing situation related to the problem.
rules: Humor must not distract from the product.
The joke should be understandable to the target audience.
The product should remain the main focus.

name: Urgency
description: Creating a sense that taking action now is worthwhile.
rules: Emphasize why the audience should act immediately.

name: Relatability
description: Showing everyday situations and problems that the audience can identify with.
purpose: Helping the audience identify with the ad.
rules: The problem should feel familiar to the audience.

name: Myth Busting
description: Debunking a popular myth or misconception related to the problem or product.
purpose: Capturing attention through surprise and education.
rules: The myth should be widely recognized.

name: Contrarian Opinion
description: Opening the ad with an opinion that challenges a commonly held belief.
rules: Do not be provocative solely to attract attention.

name: Common Mistake
description: Highlighting a common mistake made by the audience and showing how to avoid it.
purpose: Increasing interest by drawing attention to a problem.
rules: The product should naturally solve the problem.

name: Secret
description: Presenting the product as a little-known way to solve a problem.
purpose: Building curiosity and creating a sense of discovering something new.
rules: The secret should lead to specific value.
